messages:
alex: Noticed several AIs stay open for months. Proposal: strict follow-up SLA + lightweight remediation-oncall rota. Thoughts?

nina: +1. We need a short required checklist on the postmortem form (owner, ack_ts, due_ts, verification).

avex: typo :) alex: good catch.

vik: Suggestion: two-step owner model: remediation_owner (primary) + fallback-remediation (weekly rota). If owner not acked in 48h, fallback gets auto-assigned.

alex: Minimal timeline: 0h declare, 24h draft, 48h owners assigned+ack, 7d plan, 14d PR/mitigation, 30d verification/close, 90d recurrence check. Make remediation_owner required on PM form.

nina: For tooling, ops-bot should accept `/followup schedule <incident> 7d 30d` and DM owner on 7d + 30d if open.

ops-bot: I can do that. Expose `/followup create` and schedule auto-pings at ack_deadline and due_date -3d, due_date, verification_check. Use `/followup help` for options.

vik: Tracker CSV header proposal: incident_id, created_ts, severity, ai_id, summary, remediation_owner, fallback_owner, owner_ack_ts, due_ts, status, verification, linked_pr, recurrence_count, notes

alex: Also add a monthly "recurrence report" that surfaces top 10 recurring incident types (by recurrence_count) so product/infra can prioritize.

nina: I'll add a small YAML snippet to playbooks to make parsing easier: `- id: AI-01, owner: nina, due: 2024-12-01, verification: perf test`

vik: I'll pilot the rota for two weeks and help wire bot assignment logic.

alex: Action items: nina add YAML + PM form required fields (ETA 4d), vik configure ops-bot followup commands (ETA 1w), alex create remediation-oncall rota entry and add monthly recurrence report job (ETA 3d). Ping this thread when done.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-ups will alert owners automatically once enabled.

nina: Sounds good. If anyone has pushback on 48h ack SLA, speak up now.

vik: fine from infra.

alex: cool. thanks team :rocket:
